update_impact_publicly_callable.meaning: updateImpact is declared public with no access control restricting callers

mint_recorded_latest_service.meaning: mint completed and recorded the current proposalId as the latest service for its core
mint_recorded_latest_service.checkpoint: after mint, before external updateImpact call

external_call_possible.meaning: an external account can invoke the public updateImpact on an existing service NFT after mint completes

service_impact_after.meaning: _impacts[proposalId] value for the service NFT after updateImpact executes

assumptions: The external account is not an authorized maintainer of the service NFT impact score.
The service NFT already exists with a nonzero impact score before the external updateImpact call.

unresolved.description: Report does not establish whether datasetId is nonzero in the reported scenario, so the dataset impact reset is not part of this core claim.
Concrete values of _maturities and datasetImpactWeight are not specified; not needed for the selected zero-reset relation.

limitations: Only the service NFT impact reset (service_impact_zero) is formalized; dataset_impact_zero and reward_distribution_affected are deferred and not implied by this claim.
The report does not state whether the external call was observed or only possible; the plan treats it as an available external call scenario.
Authorization is represented by the absence of access control on updateImpact, not by a concrete caller identity.
